title: Expo 15 — production refresh, before / after
subtitle: The 15 brands from the 2026 Taiwan Creative Expo editorial shortlist. Slugs are listed in the Notion doc's own order (category, then rank).
warning: Slugs were protected. Three brands carry mangled slugs from the DEV-1301 defect — y for 郁郁 YùYù, ng for 雱 PĀNG, 610-asteroid-b for 小行星 B-610 (diacritics and Han dropped by slug generation, not typos). The refresh flow classifies slug as an identity field and refused every write to it, so no live URL changed and no inbound link broke. Fixing those slugs remains DEV-1301's job, and needs redirects.
